items.title: Surfaces are one list, newest first
items.detail: The Surfaces tab lists this host's and your other Work hosts' Surfaces together, by when they were last updated. Surfaces with no date come last under Date unknown. Chips filter by type: Document, Dashboard, Prototype, Interactive or Live.

items.title: The session bar keeps the title first
items.detail: In the top bar the session title leads, the host's icon and name stay on one line, and the busy or idle state stays visible, including in the narrow native title bar.

items.title: Decision cards say briefs are unavailable in one short line
items.detail: When this host can't prepare briefs, the card reads Briefs unavailable on this host; hover it for the reason.

limits: Surface type chips appear only for Surfaces whose author says what they are.
Surfaces served from a URL on another host still open only on that host.
